title: Policies: Add create/edit policy and document viewer
desc: UI only lists/publishes/archives; no create or edit policy form. Table shows metadata only; no document viewer or download.

title: Acknowledgements: Add per-policy ack list and employee workflow
desc: Page shows aggregate KPIs only; no per-employee or per-policy acknowledgement table. No employee self-acknowledge UI.

title: Exceptions: Add policy picker UX
desc: Raise form requires raw policyId UUID; no dropdown/search against policies list.

title: Reviews: Structured review form and policy context
desc: Complete Review uses window.prompt for outcome/notes. Table shows truncated policyId only; no policy title or link.

title: Certificate: Attestation UI and certificate export
desc: Sign sends hardcoded attestations [{field:attest,value:OK}]. No PDF/download or signed certificate viewer after sign.

title: Dashboard: Loading/error states and KPI drill-down
desc: No loading spinner or error UI when dashboard fetch fails. KPI tiles not clickable links to filtered sub-pages.

title: API: Add create-draft and dedicated acknowledgements API
desc: POST route supports publish/archive only; no create-draft. No /acknowledgements route; data only via dashboard aggregate.
